scope: HGTXR-SW second-goal current experiment result synthesis

center.interpretation: best validated center gate; useful as geometry/center guard rather than a complete P10/P5 solution

p10.interpretation: best validated P10 gate; remains the hardest active threshold gate

p5.interpretation: best validated P5 gate; strong but fragile under P10-focused branches

result_interpretation.reason: The current best center, P10, and P5 gates come from different experiment owners.
result_interpretation.high_value_signal: XR-63 shows complementary sample-wise predictions across the current leader set.

oracle_diagnostic.non_promotion_reason: The oracle selects among test-aligned predictions and is diagnostic only; it must be converted into train/val-only supervision before training.
oracle_diagnostic.operational_implication: Use XR-64 teacher-target construction as the leakage-safe route to test whether the oracle signal transfers.

submission_target_relation.operational_rule: Use current center/P10/P5 gates for software promotion until coordinate frame, split protocol, hybrid scheduler mode, and paper-frame/full-test P1 coverage are proven.

xr64_resume_gate.next_action_after_user_resumes: Generate XR-64 train/val teacher eval rows and override JSONs, then run the strict XR-64 checker before any XR-64A/B training.

promotion_rules: Do not promote XR-63 oracle as a trained result.
Do not compare current metric_track_center_px directly against the 0.1812 px submission target.
Do not run or claim XR-64A/B until XR-64-prep generated artifacts pass strict checking.
Promote future trained results only against current software gates unless the metric/protocol bridge is unblocked.
conclusion: Current work has identified credible accuracy headroom, but the active second goal remains incomplete: no single trained model owns all gates, XR-63 is diagnostic only, XR-64 generated artifacts are missing, and paper-level metric/protocol comparison is blocked.
